description: Fix consultation_requests RLS policies (broken because they reference 'profiles.role' but actual table is 'admin_profiles') and create the public /careers page that lists active job postings from job_postings table. These two items are independent of each other and of FEAT-001/FEAT-002.
steps:
FIX 8 — Create app/careers/page.tsx as a server component. It must:
  (a) Import createClient from @/lib/supabase/server and fetch active job postings: supabase.from('job_postings').select('id, title, slug, description, requirements, salary_range, location, employment_type, experience_level, active, created_at').eq('active', true).order('created_at', { ascending: false })
  (b) Display a page with the same visual style as app/about/page.tsx and app/services/page.tsx — light background (bg-slate-50 or white), slate-900 headings, blue-600 accents
  (c) Hero section with heading 'Join Our Team' and subtext about building innovative tech together
  (d) Job listing cards: for each job show title (font-bold text-slate-900), employment_type badge, experience_level badge, location with MapPin icon, salary_range with green text if present, description truncated to 3 lines (line-clamp-3), requirements as a bullet list (max 4 items shown), and an 'Apply Now' Button that links to '/contact?subject=Job Application: <title>'
  (e) If no active jobs, show an empty state: 'No open positions right now. Check back soon or send us your resume via the contact page.'
  (f) Export metadata with title 'Careers - Asrivo Tech'
  (g) Export dynamic = 'force-dynamic' and revalidate = 0

FIX 8 (cont.) — Add 'Careers' link to public navigation in components/header.tsx. The navigation array is at the top of the file (lines 10-17). Add { name: 'Careers', href: '/careers' } after the Projects entry. This ensures the careers page is discoverable from the navbar.
acceptance_criteria: supabase/migrations/fix_consultation_rls.sql exists with correct DROP/CREATE POLICY statements referencing admin_profiles
app/careers/page.tsx renders a list of active job postings from job_postings table
When job_postings is empty, a friendly empty state is shown
The Careers link appears in the public site navbar
pnpm run type-check passes with no new errors
verification: pnpm run type-check — zero TypeScript errors
pnpm run build — builds successfully including /careers route
